hooks.prompt:
This repo has a hard rule: ALL user-facing website copy must be written in Swedish. Code, comments, and identifiers stay in English — only rendered site copy is Swedish.

A file was just edited. The hook payload is:

$ARGUMENTS

Answer ok:true immediately, with no further analysis, if ANY of these hold:
- the edited file_path is not under app/
- the file is app/assets/css/main.scss or app/plugins/reveal.ts
- the edit did not add any new user-facing text

Otherwise answer ok:false ONLY if this edit introduced NEW user-facing text written in English rather than Swedish. User-facing text means: rendered strings and template text, headings, labels, button text, placeholders, aria-label, alt text, and the content values in app/content/wedding.ts.

Never flag: identifiers, imports, type names, TypeScript keys, CSS class names, code comments, or English text that already existed before this edit. When in doubt, answer ok:true — a false alarm costs more than a missed one here.

If you answer ok:false, quote the offending English string in your reason.
hooks.statusMessage: Checking site copy is in Swedish…
